correctness.rationale: The first-free-cell perfect-matching recursion exhaustively and uniquely enumerates every tiling, with an independent four-floor transfer recursion agreeing at 1845. Two exact flip characterizations agree on 6949 edges. Connected components, four P5 degree sequences, reflection transitivity, minimum degree 1, and all 1825-source shortest paths are asserted and checked by a runnable standalone certificate. The 29 elementary four-cycles cover every permitted 2x2 slab. This is a complete finite proof only, not a general-volume result.

value.rationale: Classical 3x3x2 three-dimensional domino tilings have disconnection partly from frozen tilings, while the adjacent 2x3x4 brick is disconnected despite every state having a legal move. The four symmetry-equivalent P5 components explicitly exhibit nontrivial mobile obstructions; the connected giant and its exact radius 10/diameter 16 provide a natural reconfiguration benchmark useful for testing flip invariants and constrained-search algorithms. This is a motivated full classification, not an arbitrary unstructured set of numbers.
